Find the skill you selected and the area of the ship in which it 
is to be used and consult the appropriate entry:

• If Listen on ‘C’-deck, go to 507.
• If Psychology on ‘B’-deck, go to 507.
• If Psychology on ‘C’-deck, go to 516.
• If Spot Hidden on ‘A’-deck, go to 507.
• If Spot Hidden on ‘D’-deck, got to 503.
• If Track on ‘C’-deck, go to 507.
• If Track on ‘D’-deck, go to 517.
When done, return to 480.
